integrity: Mathematical proof given for all cardinalities in the stated scope; independent verification has not been performed. The executable checks the finite endpoint minimization through nine components only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns one acyclic functional and inverse-functional relation without additional order-type constraints; it does not decide simultaneous multi-successor realization or computational complexity. The countably-infinite-components case is credited to prior work. Historical-priority coverage by older order theory is not exhaustive.
title: Optimal exact-successor completion of finite-component path forests
